products.name: Assortment Macaron Tower
products.description: A stunning tower featuring every flavor we offer! Perfect for parties, celebrations, or when you can't decide which flavor to try. Each macaron is handcrafted with premium ingredients and beautifully arranged in our signature gift tower.

products.name: Berry Medley Macaron
products.description: A burst of summer berries in every bite! Mixed berry compote filling featuring raspberries, blackberries, and more. Sweet, tart, and incredibly refreshing.

products.name: Cake Pop Macaron
products.description: The best of both worlds! Our signature macarons reimagined as delightful cake pops. Various flavors and designs on a lollipop stick make these as fun to eat as they are delicious.

products.name: Dark Chocolate Ganache Macaron
products.description: Intense dark chocolate ganache made with 70% cocoa Belgian chocolate. Rich, deep chocolate flavor balanced perfectly with our light, airy almond shells.

products.name: Citrus Orange Macaron
products.description: Bright, sunny orange cream filling made with fresh California oranges. Zesty, sweet, and utterly refreshing. Like a ray of sunshine in cookie form.

products.name: Coffee Espresso Macaron
products.description: For coffee lovers! Rich espresso bean-infused shells with a silky coffee buttercream. Bold, aromatic, and perfectly balanced. The perfect pick-me-up.

products.name: Ice Cream Dream Macaron
products.description: Inspired by your favorite ice cream flavors! Rotating selection of cookies and cream, mint chocolate chip, cookie dough, and more. Each bite tastes like frozen dessert heaven.

products.name: Lemon Curd Macaron
products.description: Bright, sunny lemon curd made with fresh lemons. The perfect balance of citrus brightness and sweet almond shell. A refreshing treat any time of day.

products.name: Mint Fresh Macaron
products.description: Cool, crisp mint filling made with fresh peppermint. Light and refreshing with just the right amount of sweetness. Like a breath of fresh air.

products.name: Neopolitan Dream Macaron
products.description: Three classic flavors in one! Layers of vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry come together just like the beloved ice cream. A nostalgic trip down memory lane.

products.name: Pistachio Macaron
products.description: Authentic Sicilian pistachio paste blended into our French buttercream. Nutty, earthy, and wonderfully aromatic. A true pistachio lover's dream.

products.name: Pool Party Macaron
products.description: Summer in a macaron! Inspired by your favorite popsicles and ice pops. Rotating flavors include blue raspberry, cherry, orange, and grape. Fun, fruity, and perfect for warm weather.

products.name: Rose & Raspberry Macaron
products.description: Romantic and elegant. Fragrant rose petal-infused shells with a tart-sweet raspberry jam filling. A delicate floral flavor that's unforgettable.

products.name: Salted Caramel Macaron
products.description: A fan favorite! Buttery caramel filling with fleur de sel sea salt creates the perfect sweet and salty balance. Pure indulgence in every bite.

products.name: Classic Vanilla Bean Macaron
products.description: Our signature vanilla macaron made with real Madagascar bourbon vanilla beans. Delicate almond shells sandwich a smooth, creamy vanilla bean buttercream that melts in your mouth.
